name: Cau Robat
description: Cau Robat is a children's fishing game from Catalonia, Spain. Played with a Spanish 40-card deck. Features unique 'Cau' calls and capture of sequences. Somewhat similar to Ronda but with less scope for skill.

overview.description: Cau Robat is a children's fishing game from Catalonia, Spain. Played with a Spanish 40-card deck. Features unique 'Cau' calls and capture of sequences. Somewhat similar to Ronda but with less scope for skill.

history.origins: Cau Robat is a traditional children's fishing game from Catalonia, the northeast region of Spain. It was documented by Enric Capo. The game is somewhat similar to Ronda (played in Morocco) but with less emphasis on skill.
timeline: Traditional: Played for generations in Catalonia
history.cultural: Part of Catalan card game tradition. Played primarily by children. The name 'Cau Robat' reflects the game's mechanics (Cau = capture call, Robat = stolen).
history.evolution: The game has remained a regional tradition in Catalonia. It uses the standard Spanish deck and follows traditional fishing game mechanics with local variations.

setup.players: 3-5 players (usual number), any number can play.
setup.deck: Standard Spanish 40-card deck: four suits (swords, cups, coins, clubs), ranks 1-7 and 10-12 (Sota/Valet=10, Cavall/Horse=11, Rei/King=12). Only ranks matter.

rules.objective: The aim is to take more cards than your opponents. Players capture cards by matching ranks or by taking unbroken ascending sequences (10 follows 7, 1 follows 12). The player with the most cards at the end of the hand wins that hand; the first to win an agreed number of hands wins the game.
rules.gameplay: Play follows fishing game mechanics with unique 'Cau' calls. Players capture by matching ranks or forming sequences. Sequences wrap: 10 follows 7, and 1 follows 12 (e.g., 5-6-7-10-11 and 11-12-1-2-3 are valid). Special rules for 'Cau' calls and table cleaning. Game involves payments in cards for certain calls and cleaning the table.
keyRules: Payments in cards for certain situations

strategy.basic: Make captures when possible. Remember sequence possibilities.
strategy.intermediate: Track which cards have been played. Plan for sequence captures.
strategy.advanced: Optimal timing of Cau calls. Managing table state.
tips: Track played cards for sequence planning
